'''Bryn Samsin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], native to the planet [[Makeb]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], the Protectors evacuation camps was attacked by former mercenaries of [[InterStellar Regulators]] to capture hostages and use them to negotiate for seats aboard [[the Ark]]. Bryn asked [[Tad Belanger]] to exact revenge on said mercenaries and rescue the hostages. Tad refused as the primary goal of his organization was humanitarian actions, but Bryn was lucky enough to have a Republic strike force in the area during the argument.
